title: Malignant Versus Benign Tumors of the Sinonasal Cavity: A Case-Control Study on Occupational Etiology

record.paper_title: Malignant Versus Benign Tumors of the Sinonasal Cavity: A Case-Control Study on Occupational Etiology
record.source_excerpt: Odds ratios (OR) with 95% confidence intervals (CI) associated with selected occupations were obtained by a multinomial and exact logistic regression.
record.modeling_hypothesis: Multinomial logistic regression was applied to assess the relationship between occupations and multiple tumor types, yielding odds ratios and confidence intervals.

record.source_excerpt: On the exact logistic regression, the OR associated to the textile industry was 9.32 (95%CI = 1.10–Inf) for ADC, and 7.21 (95%CI = 0.55–Inf) for NAET.
record.modeling_hypothesis: Exact logistic regression was used to analyze the association between textile industry occupation and specific sinonasal tumor types, providing odds ratios with confidence intervals.
